title: 1980 Dodge Colt
description:
🚗 1980 Dodge Colt
– Twin‑Stick Manual – Complete Project Car
$2,100 OBO – Lewisville, TX

If you’re into vintage Mitsubishis, DSM history, or quirky 80s engineering, this one’s worth a look. This is a complete 1980 Dodge Colt with the rare Twin‑Stick “Super Shift” 8‑speed manual transmission. It’s all there and untouched — a great foundation for a restoration, resto‑mod, or drivetrain donor.

⭐ Highlights:
• 	Twin‑Stick manual transmission (Super Shift 8‑speed)
• 	Complete car — nothing major missing
• 	Engine ran when purchased (I haven’t tried to start it since)
• 	Clean title in hand
• 	Texas car — not a rust‑belt survivor
• 	Rolls and steers easily for loading

🔧 Condition:
-	Non‑running currently. It ran when I bought it at auction five years ago, but I never attempted to drive it.
-	Interior is very rough — seats, panels, and carpet all need love.
-	Exterior is complete with all trim, lights, glass, etc. Body is straight overall for its age.
Great candidate for:
-	Restoration
-	Engine swap
-	Vintage autocross build (why I bought it)
-	DSM/Mitsubishi collector project
-	Parts donor (Twin‑Stick setups are hard to find)


💬 Why I’m Selling:
Too many projects and not enough time. I bought it as just a fun car to drive around since it has Twin-Stick shifters, but I’m moving to Washington state and can’t bring all my vehicles with me since they ban double-towing there. I’d rather see it go to someone who appreciates these early Mitsubishi‑built Colts and the rare shifter design.

💵 Price:
$2,100 OBO
Cash, Venmo, or Zelle. Open to reasonable offers. 

📍 Location:
Lewisville, TX
